title: A knowledge-guided agentic framework for mitigating patient-context ambiguity in health queries
abstract: arXiv:2608.19875v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Patients often submit short, underspecified queries to healthcare chatbots that lack the patient-specific information needed to determine an appropriate response. Although these queries may be linguistically clear, they can support multiple plausible answers depending on undisclosed factors such as symptoms, diagnoses, medications, allergies, or dietary restrictions. A language model answering such a query directly may therefore rely on unsupported assumptions about the patient. We introduce a knowledge-guided agentic framework for mitigating patient-context ambiguity before final response generation. The framework operates between the patient and an otherwise unchanged downstream language model. It interprets the initial query, uses a task-specific knowledge graph to construct a set of plausible hypotheses, identifies the missing patient-context variables needed to distinguish among them, and asks targeted follow-up questions. translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19875v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：患者通常向医疗聊天机器人提交简短、未充分说明的查询，这些查询缺乏确定适当回应所需的患者特定信息。尽管这些查询在语言上可能清晰，但根据未披露的因素（如症状、诊断、药物、过敏或饮食限制），它们可能支持多种合理的答案。直接回答此类查询的语言模型可能因此依赖于对患者的无根据假设。我们引入了一种知识引导的智能体框架，在最终响应生成之前缓解患者上下文歧义。该框架在患者和原本不变的下游语言模型之间运行。它解释初始查询，使用特定任务的知识图谱构建一组合理的假设，识别区分这些假设所需的缺失患者上下文变量，并提出针对性的后续问题。原始模型...
tldr: 该框架通过在患者与语言模型之间引入知识图谱驱动的智能体，主动识别并询问缺失的患者上下文信息，从而缓解健康查询中的歧义问题。
en_tdlr: This framework introduces a knowledge-graph-driven agent between patients and language models to actively identify and query missing patient-context information, thereby mitigating ambiguity in health queries.
